title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW 

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). 

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. 

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. 

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. 

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory. 

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem. 

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research. 

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English. 

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES 

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation. 

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY 

Please prepare a single PDF file containing: 

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above. 

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

Facilities Manager – Data Center

The Role

The Facilities Manager leads a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, contractors, and service providers responsible for maintaining highly available, mission-critical data center infrastructure.

This position oversees daily facilities operations, maintenance programs, capital projects, vendor performance, safety, compliance, and operational risk. The Facilities Manager drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, sustainability initiatives, strong technical governance, and proactive asset management.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facilities Operations

- Lead the day-to-day operation of all critical data center infrastructure.

- Ensure the availability and reliability of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, security, and life-safety systems.

- Maintain compliance with Service Level Agreements, operational standards, and uptime objectives.

- Oversee 24/7 operational support, including incident response, escalation, and recovery.

- Ensure Standard Operating Procedures, Emergency Operating Procedures, and Methods of Procedure are accurate, current, and consistently followed.

- Review and approve high-risk maintenance activities and changes affecting critical infrastructure.

- Support capacity planning and ensure infrastructure can meet current and future operational requirements.

Leadership and Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop Critical Facilities Engineers and Technicians.

- Manage shift schedules, staffing levels, technical training, competency assessments, and performance evaluations.

- Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.

- Foster a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement.

- Coordinate contractor and vendor activities to ensure work is completed safely, on time, and to the required quality standards.

- Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of facilities personnel.

Maintenance and Asset Management

- Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, condition-based, and corrective maintenance programs.

- Manage maintenance planning, scheduling, work orders, and equipment records through the Computerized Maintenance Management System.

- Ensure maintenance activities are properly risk-assessed, documented, approved, and communicated.

- Monitor equipment condition and lifecycle performance and develop repair, upgrade, and replacement strategies.

- Ensure maintenance activities minimize operational risk, service disruption, and unplanned downtime.

- Review recurring equipment failures and implement long-term corrective actions.

- Maintain accurate asset registers, maintenance records, technical documentation, and spare-parts inventories.

Infrastructure Management

Oversee the operation and maintenance of critical systems, including:

- Medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution systems

- Uninterruptible Power Supply systems and battery plants

- Standby diesel generators

- Automatic Transfer Switches

- Switchgear, transformers, protection systems, and electrical panels

- Chillers and chilled-water systems

- Computer Room Air Handling and Computer Room Air Conditioning units

- Air Handling Units

- Pumps and hydronic systems

- Heat exchangers

- Building Management Systems

- Data Center Infrastructure Management systems

- Fire detection and suppression systems

- Security and access-control systems

- Fuel storage and distribution systems

- Water-treatment and leak-detection systems

Health, Safety, Environmental and Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with the French Labour Code, applicable EU directives, French environmental regulations, local requirements, and company policies.

- Maintain a strong health, safety, and environmental culture across the facility.

- Manage Permit to Work, Lockout/Tagout, electrical isolation, hot-work, confined-space, and contractor-safety programs.

- Ensure employees and contractors hold the appropriate training, authorizations, and certifications for their assigned work.

- Lead incident, near-miss, and equipment-failure investigations.

- Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed.

- Prepare for and support regulatory inspections, customer assessments, insurance reviews, and internal and external audits.

- Ensure appropriate emergency-response plans, drills, and escalation procedures are maintained.

Capital Projects and Commissioning

- Support the planning and delivery of infrastructure upgrades, replacements, expansions, and capital projects.

- Review technical designs, specifications, risk assessments, and commissioning plans.

- Coordinate project work with operations teams to minimize risk to live services.

- Participate in factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and integrated systems testing.

- Ensure complete operational handover, including training, asset documentation, test results, warranties, and as-built drawings.

- Monitor project budgets, schedules, risks, and contractor performance.

Financial and Vendor Management

- Develop and manage the facilities operating and capital budgets.

- Forecast maintenance, staffing, utility, equipment-replacement, and service-contract costs.

- Review maintenance contracts, statements of work, and service-level agreements.

- Monitor vendor performance against established service levels and key performance indicators.

- Conduct regular vendor-performance reviews and implement improvement plans when required.

- Support the procurement of equipment, spare parts, technical services, and facility-related contracts.

- Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising safety, reliability, or compliance.

Sustainability and Energy Management

- Identify and implement opportunities to improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact.

- Monitor Power Usage Effectiveness, energy consumption, water consumption, and carbon-related performance.

- Support sustainability programs and environmental reporting requirements.

- Work with engineering and operations teams to optimize cooling, electrical loading, and equipment performance.

- Evaluate energy-saving initiatives while protecting system reliability and redundancy.

Operational Reporting

Track, analyze, and report key operational metrics, including:

- Infrastructure availability

- Preventive maintenance completion

- Corrective-maintenance backlog

- Mean Time to Repair

- Mean Time Between Failures

- Power Usage Effectiveness

- Energy and water consumption

- Capacity utilization

- Incident and alarm trends

- Vendor performance

- Safety performance

- Budget performance

Prepare accurate operational reports and recommendations for senior leadership and relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related technical discipline.

- A master’s degree is advantageous but not required.

- Equivalent technical education combined with substantial relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

- Minimum of seven years of experience in critical facilities, mission-critical operations, industrial facilities, or a comparable technical environment.

- At least three years of experience leading technical teams, contractors, or service providers.

- Experience in hyperscale data centers, colocation facilities, hospitals, power generation, manufacturing, utilities, or other continuously operating facilities is highly desirable.

- Demonstrated experience managing critical maintenance activities and operational risk.

- Experience managing budgets, vendors, maintenance contracts, and capital projects.

Technical Knowledge

Strong working knowledge of:

- Critical electrical infrastructure

- Medium-voltage and low-voltage distribution

- UPS systems, batteries, standby generators, and transfer systems

- HVAC and mission-critical cooling systems

- Chilled-water and hydronic systems

- Building Management Systems

- Data Center Infrastructure Management systems

- Computerized Maintenance Management Systems

- Preventive and predictive maintenance practices

- Equipment lifecycle and reliability management

- Risk assessment and root-cause analysis

- Commissioning and integrated systems testing

- Permit-to-work and energy-isolation procedures

- Data center redundancy, resilience, and uptime principles

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

- Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

- Appropriate French electrical authorization under NF C 18-510 , such as B0/H0V, B1V, B2V, BR, BC, H1V, H2V, or HC , depending on the responsibilities assigned.

- Sauveteur Secouriste du Travail certification , or equivalent workplace first-aid qualification.

- Training and experience in French hot-work authorization and control procedures, including the Permis de feu .

- France Chimie/UIC N1 or N2 safety training , or equivalent site-safety qualification, where required by the facility.

- Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Specialist , Accredited Operations Specialist, or a comparable critical-facilities certification.

- Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 , or an equivalent is advantageous.

- Training in fire safety, environmental compliance, contractor safety, or occupational risk prevention is beneficial.

- Fluent English is required; professional French-language proficiency is highly desirable.

Leadership Competencies

- Strong safety leadership

- Strategic and operational planning

- Technical team development

- Sound decision-making under pressure

- Operational excellence

- Vendor and stakeholder management

- Budget and cost management

- Risk identification and mitigation

- Continuous improvement

- Ability to lead effectively in a 24/7 mission-critical environment

Benefits & Perks:

title: Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
description:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery 

About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do 

- Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

- Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

- Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

- Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

- Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

- Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

- Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

- Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.

- Keep it trustworthy. Treat explainability, control, and guardrails as first-class requirements so customers trust and adopt agentic experiences.

- Grow the mandate. Expand from business tooling into chapter-wide leadership across the full agentic portfolio and the integrations beneath it.

What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have:

- Shipped a dashboard and tooling experience that gives business teams real transparency into and control over Constructor's agentic experiences, adopted by internal teams and customers.

- Driven measurable lift in the usage and business impact (conversion, revenue) of agentic experiences across multiple customers.

- Stood up a repeatable process for launching and experimenting with new agentic interfaces, measurably shortening time-to-launch.

- Defined the core metrics for agentic discovery and made them visible in one place.

- Begun uniting the on-site, offsite, and integrations teams behind one coherent direction for the chapter.

What We're Looking For 

- Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in AI/ML, agentic, search, or discovery products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

- A track record of moving business metrics at scale — usage, conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

- Experience building for business users/operators (merchandisers, category managers, or similar) — especially the tooling, dashboards, and controls they rely on.

- Strong AI/ML/LLM product depth — understands how agentic and LLM-powered experiences work and can reason about their tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost, reliability).

- Comfort with zero-to-one ambiguity and with scaling — able to experiment on brand-new interfaces and to build the repeatable process that turns them into a portfolio.

- A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every experience back to usage and business outcomes.

- Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of success, working shoulder-to-shoulder with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market.

- A strong instinct for trust — treating transparency, control, and guardrails as core to whether agentic experiences succeed.

- Comfort setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits 

- Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

- A competitive compensation package including stock options.

- Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

- Fully remote team — choose where you live.

- Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

- Apple laptops provided for new employees.

- Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

- Parental leave for qualified employees.

- Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io , we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice . After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity. 

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.

Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

The role - Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
- Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
- Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
- Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
- Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
- Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
- Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
- Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
- Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 

What we need from you - You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
- You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
- You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
- You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
- You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
- Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
- Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
- You communicate clearly and confidently in English

What we offer - Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
- City center office location including home office option  
- EGYM Wellpass membership support 
- Educational budget for every employee 
- Team events, summer & winter parties
- Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   

Sounds good to you? Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.  

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. 

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. 

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. 

These tasks interest you - Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. 
- Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. 
- Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. 
- Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. 
- Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. 

That makes you stand out - You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. 
- You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . 
- You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . 
- Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
- Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required. 

Salary information Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Government Solutions (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO At LiveEO, we combine Space Technology with AI to solve problems here on Earth. Our satellite-based monitoring solutions help Infrastructure operators and industrial companies to make their operations more ecological, safer, and more efficient.

LiveEO is applying the latest developments in artificial intelligence to analyse satellite data and is bringing the insights of earth observation data to customers in the enterprise sector. LiveEO’s ambitious goal is to monitor 1 billion assets across the globe with its unique SaaS solution until 2030. Our team is as global as the satellite data we process and the customers we serve. Together, we are building something big.

Our Government team is growing fast: dedicated business development for Germany and for EU institutions, with more to come. What it doesn't have yet is marketing — the force multiplier. As our first dedicated Government marketing hire, you will build LiveEO's defence & government marketing from the ground up: positioning, content, PR and events, as a true generalist who owns the whole picture.

Your challenge 1. Positioning & product marketing - Own government/defence positioning, messaging and value propositions — resilience, situational awareness, ISR — across LiveEO's offering including our own satellite constellation, Twinspector
- Build and maintain the collateral suite: capability briefs, decks, one-pagers, materials supporting tenders and more
- Own the government presence on the LiveEO website and keep messaging sharp against competitor/peer positioning in the European defence-tech and EO landscape
2. Strategic communications, Content, PR & visibility - Build and execute the strategic communications and content plan: white papers, expert articles, use-case stories
- Own press releases and announcements (contracts, partnerships, milestones) together with leadership
- Build relationships with defence, security and space trade media across Germany and Europe
- Drive executive visibility: LinkedIn presence, interviews, speaking opportunities for the Government leadership
3. Events - Own the defence & government event calendar across Europe (e.g. AFCEA, Berlin Security Conference, ILA, Eurosatory, space/EO industry events and NATO-affiliated formats)
- Run participation end-to-end: selection and budget, booth/presence, speaking slots, briefing the BD team, structured lead follow-up
4. Build the function
- Create the Government marketing playbook from scratch — processes, templates, agency/freelancer network where needed
- Keep a simple view of what works (share of voice, inbound interest, event outcomes) and feed it back into planning with BD and central marketing

Your profile - 6–7+ years of marketing, sales or similar experience in the defense or secutiry sector. You are familiar with defence-tech, military lingo and communication towards armed forces.
- Generalist track record covering product marketing, content, PR and events — not just one discipline
- Excellent writing and editing in German (C1+) and English — from press release to capability brief
- Understanding of how government/defense organizations communicate and procure (protocol, sensitivity, long cycles)
- Based in or willing to relocate to Berlin (hybrid); willingness to travel ~20–30% across Europe
- Eligibility for security clearance (typically requiring EU or NATO citizenship)
- Familiarity with Earth observation, space or geospatial technology is a plus
- Additional European languages (French especially useful for EU/NATO scope) is a plus
- Public affairs / government relations exposure is a plus

Your Benefits - Gain direct insights into and influence strategic business decisions shaping our go-to-market (GTM) strategy, while working on cutting-edge SaaS and AI solutions that enhance business processes and lives globally.

title: Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. Our platforms Treeline, SurfaceScout, and TradeAware, help utilities, energy companies, rail operators, and global supply chains monitor vegetation risk, third-party interference, ground changes, and deforestation exposure across millions of kilometers of assets and supply chains, from space.

We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. This is a player-leader role for someone who has run distributed technical teams before, speaks fluently in geospatial and remote-sensing technology, has sold software-enabled services rather than pure-play SaaS, and has embedded MEDDPICC and value-selling discipline into a sales engine at scale.

As Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x), you will own the strategy, people, and technical rigor behind LiveEO's global pre-sales motion. You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. You'll partner closely with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, and Product leadership to make sure every region sells with the same technical credibility, the same value discipline, and the same customer-first mindset.

Your challenge 1. Global Team Leadership - Build, lead, and scale an international Sales Engineering team across North America, EMEA, and APAC; own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for regional SEs and SE managers.

- Set global SE strategy, headcount plan, and capacity model aligned to pipeline coverage and quota targets.

- Establish consistent standards, certification, and career pathing so SEs anywhere in the world operate at the same bar.

- Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaborative deal support across regions and time zones.

title: Senior Consultant Search, Content & AI Visibility (SEO/GEO) (m/w/d), München
description:
Wofür wir stehen: “We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.” Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit. Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact. Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. 

Deine Aufgaben: Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

- Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
- Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
- Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
- Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
- AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
- AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
- Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
- Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
- Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
- Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
- AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
- Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.

Damit kannst Du punkten: - Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
- Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
- Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
- GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
- Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
- B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
- Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
- Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
- Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
- Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
- Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.

Was wir von Dir benötigen: Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir: 
- Deinen CV 
- Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
- Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin 

Warum wir? Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen . Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser. - T eamspirit pur : Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
- Transparente Strukturen : Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
- Open Vacation Policy : Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
- Work from anywhere : Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten : Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
- Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen : Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
- Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
- Wachstum garantiert : Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
- Karrierepfade : Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
- Mobility & Events : Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
- Loft-Offices : Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
- Rewards : Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge.

Diese Position ist im Consulting Cluster von TOWA auf Senior-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €60.000 und €75.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in) . Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt. 

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern. 

Chancengleichheit 

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d). 

Deine Führungskraft Dein Teamlead ist Anja Meusburger – Klicke hier um mehr über sie zu erfahren.

- Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
- Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
- AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
- Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.

Damit kannst Du punkten: - Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
- Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
- Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. - GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. - Tracking bauen: Du setzt Tracking-Setups in GTM auf, inklusive server-side Container, sauber aufgesetzt auf Consent Mode v2 und die Realität aus ITP-Caps, Consent-Verlusten und Adblockern. Cloud-Infrastruktur, DNS und Pipelines kommen von MarTech und Data & BI – die Messlogik ist deine.
- Datenqualität durchsetzen: Du validierst, debuggst und dokumentierst. Du erkennst ein Setup, das plausible, aber falsche Zahlen liefert – und du sagst es, auch wenn das Dashboard seit zwei Jahren im Management-Meeting hängt.
- Von Rohdaten zur Aussage: GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Matomo.Otterly.AI. Du arbeitest jenseits der GA4-Oberfläche und lieferst drei belastbare Aussagen statt dreißig Charts – inklusive der Unsicherheit, die du benennst.
- Reportinglogik definieren: Du legst Metriken, Granularität und Reportingrhythmus fest und spezifizierst die Dashboards. Den Build machst du gemeinsam mit Data & BI (Power BI, Looker Studio).

- Datenschutzkonform messen: Du verantwortest die technische Umsetzung – CMP-Setups (Usercentrics, Cookiebot, OneTrust), Consent-Signale, Datenminimierung – in Abstimmung mit Rechtsabteilung bzw. Datenschutzbeauftragten des Kunden, nicht als Rechtsberatung.
- Verantwortung im Retainer: Du betreust mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
- Beratung, die verständlich bleibt: Du erklärst server-side Tagging einer Geschäftsführung so, dass sie die Investition versteht – und einem Vertriebsleiter deine Analyse so, dass er danach anders handelt.
- AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs für Analyse, Abfragen und Dokumentation – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht. Bei Analysearbeit ist das ein echter Hebel, kein Nice-to-have.
- Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen, arbeitest eng mit Search, Performance, MarTech und Data & BI zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass ein Setup eine Übergabe übersteht.

- GTM in der Tiefe: Client- und server-side. Du weißt, warum HTTP-only-Cookies über einen Same-Site-Subdomain-Endpoint der eigentliche Punkt beim Server-Side-Tagging sind – und nicht die Server selbst.

- GA4 und darüber hinaus: GA4 sicher, BigQuery-Export und SQL selbstverständlich. Du weißt, wo die GA4-Oberfläche aufhört, verlässlich zu sein.
- Betriebswirtschaftliche Herleitung: Du kannst eine Kennzahl definieren, bevor du sie messen kannst – und erklären, welche Entscheidung sie stützen soll. Wer nur auf Tool-Ebene spricht, ist hier falsch.

- Nice to have: Erfahrung mit SEO-Reporting, Marketing-Mix-Modellierung oder dbt.

Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. - Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities - Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

- Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

- Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

- Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

- Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

- Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

- Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

- Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

- Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

- Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

- Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

- Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

- Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

- Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

- Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions

Your profile Apply if this describes you:

- You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

- You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

- You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

- You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

- You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

- You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

- You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

- You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

- You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

- Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

- You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

- You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

- You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

- You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

- You are based in Berlin

- You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

- Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.

Why us? - Sell a product people are excited about

- Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

- Work directly with the founders and senior team

- Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

- Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

- See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

- Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

- Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

- Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application - Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

- Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

- If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

- Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description:
Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. 
This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. 
The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. 
You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. 
This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. 

What you will work on - Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

- Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

- Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

- Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads

- Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

- Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

- Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

- Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

- Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

- Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

- Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

- Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries

- Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows

Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

- Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

- Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

- Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

- Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

- Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA , and GPU scheduling

- The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

- A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

- Very good English; German is a plus

We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.

Nice to have - Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

- Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

- Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF , photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

- Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

- Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

- Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

- Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements

Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others! You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity. Develop yourself! We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally. And there is even more! Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.

What is your Day to Day Mission: 

- Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.

- Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.

- Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.

- Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.

description:
Your mission We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Chief of Staff (f/m/d) to join the leadership team at deeploi.

In this role, you act as a strategic and operational partner to the CEO , driving cross-functional alignment, owning our financial steering, and making sure decisions are taken and executed across the company.

You combine sharp financial judgment with organisational excellence, acting as a bridge between strategy, finance and execution , as we build deeploi into a company with sustainable, profitable growth.

This is a highly visible role with a wide scope. Wherever a topic matters and has no clear home, you take it, own it end to end, and drive it to a result. You set a high bar for yourself and the people around you.

Your Responsibilities 

- Own strategic projects: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from first structure to final delivery.
- Shape our commercial model: Drive how we position, package and price our product as we expand our SaaS offering and open up new go-to-market tiers.
- Lead financial steering & reporting: Own business planning, forecasts, investor reporting and performance tracking, as well as accounting, billing and our external finance partners.
- Structure how we run: Drive OKRs, decision-making and cross-functional collaboration for clarity and accountability, shape the formats that hold the team together and, together with People, connect company OKRs to performance management and feedback.
- Partner with leadership: Act as a trusted thought partner to the Founders and the leadership team, including sparring on People initiatives.
- Own legal & contracts: Take responsibility for customer contracts and contractual updates, coordinate external legal support, manage our public funding topics and drive our ISO topics.

Your profile - 5+ years of experience in consulting , investment or strategic and finance roles in a startup or scale-up, for example as a Chief of Staff, in a founder’s office, or in a senior finance role.

- Hands-on and entrepreneurial , with the detail orientation to push until something is excellent and the standards to raise the bar around you.
- Excellent strategic thinking and communication : you translate between strategy, finance and operations, and challenge constructively at senior level.
- Comfortable in a high performance culture with fast pace, changing priorities and broad responsibility.
- High integrity, trustworthiness and discretion in handling sensitive information.
- Fluent German (ideally C2) and business fluent English (C1).
- You are in our Berlin office 3 to 4 days a week , and you make in-person culture something people want, not something they comply with.

Why us? - A key role in the leadership team with real ownership, impact and visibility, working directly alongside both Founders on the topics that decide where deeploi goes next.
- Join a B2B SaaS company backed by Atomico, Cherry Ventures and other leading investors.

- You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
- You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.

title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
description:
At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

Tasks

What You'll Do

- Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.

- Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.

- Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.

- Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.

- Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.

- Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.

- Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.

Requirements

Must have

- 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.

- Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.

- Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation.

- Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.

- Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.

Nice to have

- Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.

- Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.

- Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.

- SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.

Benefits

- Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.

- Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.

- Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.

- Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.

- An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.

- Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

title: Performance Marketing Manager:in (all genders) für Paid Ads, Creatives und KI
description:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Unser Wachstum hängt an zwei Seiten gleichzeitig. Wer etwas verschicken will, braucht jemanden, der es mitnimmt. Wer mitnehmen will, braucht Aufträge auf seiner Strecke. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind.

Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.11. in Vollzeit als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀

Aufgaben

- Paid-Kanäle verantworten 

Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt.

- Den ganzen Funnel im Blick 

Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden.

- Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie 

Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen.

- Creative-Pipeline 

Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert.

- Testing-Programm 

Du testest systematisch statt nach Bauchgefühl. Von der Hypothese über das Setup bis zur sauberen Auswertung. Learnings dokumentierst du so, dass das ganze Team sie nutzen kann.

- KI und eigene Tools 

Du arbeitest KI-first. Mit Claude Code baust du dir eigene Tools für Auswertung, Reporting, Automatisierung und Creative-Varianten. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

- Performance sichtbar machen 

Du lieferst ein klares wöchentliches Reporting für Team und Gründer:innen. Nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern was wir jetzt tun sollten.

- Trends und Plattform-Änderungen 

Neue Formate, Algorithmus-Updates, Veränderungen bei Tracking und Attribution. Du hast sie auf dem Schirm, bevor sie uns treffen, und leitest ab, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet.

- Datenschnittstelle im Marketing 

Du wirst Ansprechperson für Datenfragen aus CRM, SEO und Social Media und verbindest die Zahlen zu einem Bild.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und dabei eigenständig Budget verantwortet. Idealerweise bei einer App, auf einem Marktplatz oder in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.

Meta Ads und Google Ads kennst du in der Tiefe. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur aufgesetzt, sondern Account-Strukturen gebaut, Budgets über mehrere Kanäle gesteuert und auf Events jenseits des Installs optimiert. Erfahrung mit Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Mobile-Attribution und Tracking-Setups ist ein klares Plus.

Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Tool-Wissen:

- Du denkst in Funnels, nicht in Downloads. Ein günstiger Install, aus dem nie ein Transport wird, ist für dich kein Erfolg.

- Du arbeitest datenbasiert. Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sauber und sagst auch, wenn ein Test nichts gebracht hat.

- Du nutzt KI täglich und hast Lust, dir mit Claude Code eigene Workflows zu bauen.

- Du kennst die Trends im Paid-Bereich und bringst neue Ideen mit, bevor jemand danach fragt.

- Du triffst Budgetentscheidungen selbst und kannst sie mit Zahlen begründen.

- Du schreibst Ad Copy, die unsere Zielgruppe wirklich trifft.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle : Arbeite, wann und wo es für dich am besten passt

- Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote : Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm

- Offsites mit dem Team : Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr

- Free MUVN Rides : Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren

- Corporate Benefits : Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Antwort auf diese Frage:

Performance Marketing für einen Marktplatz wie MUVN funktioniert anders als für einen Onlineshop oder eine klassische App. Wir brauchen Menschen, die etwas verschicken, und Fahrer:innen, die es mitnehmen, am besten auf derselben Strecke. Was würdest du bei uns anders angehen? Und auf welche Kennzahl würdest du als Erstes schauen?

Es gibt keine richtige Antwort. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst.

Oder schick uns ein kurzes Video dazu. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.

So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit Katharina, dann eine Session mit Jule an einem echten Case aus unseren Kampagnen, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.

Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.

Let's get it muvn. 🚀
