- Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

- Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software einzuarbeiten.

- Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

- Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz und stabiles Internet für deine Arbeitsblöcke.

Nice-to-have 

- Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

- Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung – auch wenn sie Jahre zurückliegt.

- Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

- Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools: Prompts, Formeln, Filter, einfache Automatisierungen.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by! 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a savvy Senior Analyst, Data Operations & Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you!

Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight.

From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations.

Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive.

What you'll be responsible for: 

- Develop a deep understanding of Hospitality’s business processes, systems, customers, and underlying data architecture to provide meaningful analysis and support operational excellence within the Pod.

- Develop exploratory and reusable data models leveraging diverse data sources, supporting business partners with insightful datasets, reporting, dashboards, and clear analytical recommendations.

- Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical requirements, approaches, and solutions that address the underlying business need.

- Be the bridge between the Data Office and the broader Hospitality organization, turning complexity into clarity and ensuring clear communication of assumptions, findings, limitations, and implications.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and data flows, and use analysis to help Hospitality teams make more informed and effective decisions.

- Monitor and improve data quality by investigating discrepancies at the source, documenting findings, communicating impact, and driving continuous improvement across the relevant teams.

- Collaborate with the Data Office to establish analytical standards and best practices, improve documentation and definitions, and mentor junior team members.

And a little bit of... .

- Stay up to date with developments, innovations, and trends in data, including state-of-the-art machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).

- Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

Who you are: 

- 4+ years in an analytical role, with strong experience in data operations, business intelligence, reporting, or process optimization.

- Strong experience translating business stakeholder challenges and needs into technical requirements, analytical approaches, and practical solutions.

- Excellent SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures and multiple data sources; willingness to learn new tools and data systems.

- Experience developing data models, datasets, dashboards, and reporting that are accurate, reusable, and accessible to business partners.

- Experience in Hospitality, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Sales, or another operational business environment will give you a head start.

- Strong business acumen and a knack for bridging the gap between technical challenges, analytical findings, and business strategy.

- Enjoy tackling complex problems through meticulous research, structured analysis, critical thinking, and creative but pragmatic solutions.

- Meticulous with data accuracy and quality, with a keen eye for spotting anomalies, investigating root causes, and understanding the impact of data issues.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex problems, analytical results, and recommendations with clarity and impact.

- A drive to deliver results, strong organizational skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to drive projects autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, GitHub, and Salesforce is a plus.

- Familiarity with Segment, Heap type of tools

What’s in it for you: 

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

- Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

- Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

- Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

- Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

- Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services 

- ​​Health and wellness benefit 

- Volunteer day to be able to give back to society!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. 

Where to from here? 

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are: 

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement .

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Advertising Technology Solutions
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Enterprise Account Executive - Mirakl Ads

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Ads team led by Andreas Preuer , VP Sales Ads. The team consists of 7 professionals covering the EMEA region. Together, you'll be empowering businesses to monetise their ecommerce web traffic across both marketplace and first-party offerings while delivering more value to advertisers, marketplace sellers, and publishers. 

Your Impact 

- 
Develop and execute a go-to-market sales strategy for Mirakl Ads across EMEA territory, owning quota attainment through a structured, repeatable approach to new customer acquisition within retailer and marketplace operator. 

- 
Manage the full end-to-end sales cycle (typically 5 to 9 months) across all stages: prospecting and outbound engagement, discovery and business case development, technical validation with the solution engineering team, commercial negotiation with procurement and legal, and contract closure. 

- 
Build deep expertise in Mirakl Ads and act as a trusted advisor on retail media monetisation strategies, sponsored product mechanics, and advertiser ROI, positioning Mirakl's differentiators against competing retail media solutions. 

- 
Navigate complex retailer organisations to build and maintain senior-level relationships with the key decision-makers driving retail media initiatives, including: Chief Digital Officers, VP/Heads of eCommerce, Heads of Retail Media or Monetisation, CMOs, as well as engaging technical and legal stakeholders throughout the process 

- 
Own and grow a healthy, multi-stage pipeline, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Legal teams to accelerate deal progression and ensure a smooth transition to onboarding post-signature 

Experience 

- 6+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS or Ad-tech/Retail Media sales, with a consistent track record 

- Proven ability to manage and prioritise a pipeline, accelerating sales cycles to deliver against quarterly and annual revenue goals 

- Skilled in solution selling and ROI-based selling, with experience engaging technical and business stakeholders across multiple levels (from practitioners to C-suite) 

- Negotiation skills with a track record of closing mid-to-large enterprise deals 

- Experience using CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce) to manage forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and reporting 

Nice to Have 

- Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem: DSPs, ad servers, APIs, and data-driven media buying 

- Experience in marketplace platforms or eCommerce environments 

- Comfortable leveraging AI-powered sales tools (e.g. Gong, Dust) to improve prospecting, call preparation, and deal reviews 

- Additional European language (French, German, Spanish) is a plus 

Languages 

- English: C2 level (required) 

We keep it transparent and timely. Here’s what to expect: 

- Introductory call : A conversation to learn about your background and motivations, and to answer your questions about Mirakl, the team, and the role. 

- Business interview Meet the hiring manager to discuss your experience, problem‑solving approach and impact. 

- Values Interviews : Meet with team members from different functions to explore your alignment with our core values and ways of working. 

- Final decision & offer : We consolidate feedback quickly and aim to share decisions without delay. If successful, we’ll walk you through the offer details, benefits, and next steps. 

Benefits at Mirakl : 

- Public Transport Pass: 50% reimbursement on your monthly public transport subscription. 

- Health Insurance: Flexible coverage tailored to individual or family needs, with Mirakl contributing to your plan. 

- Meal Allowance: Mirakl provide a monthly meal allowance. 

- Hybrid Setup: 4 days in-office & 1 day remote. 

- Pension & Life Insurance: Mirakl contributes monthly to your pension and covers 100% of life insurance premiums.

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI? 

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role 

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing 

- Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

- Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

- Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

- Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

- Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. - Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. - Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

Create the Future of Travel With Us

Whether it's visiting the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is essential.

Yet we've all experienced the aches and pains of getting to our destination.

Engineering at Duffel

We're building tools to simplify travel distribution, search, and booking through one seamless API. The technical challenge? Design a world class API, then integrate it with a vast number of travel providers - each with different systems and requirements - whilst delivering a fantastic developer experience.

We work with Elixir, Phoenix, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over specific tech experience.

As a Senior Engineer, you won't just execute against a spec - you'll help define what gets built and how. You'll take on ambiguous problems, shape technical decisions across teams, and set a bar for quality that others follow.

✅ You've mentored engineers or helped them do their best work, and take real satisfaction in others reaching the bar you hold yourself to

✅ You communicate clearly, articulating what you're working on, why, and the reasoning behind your tradeoffs, in a structured way, to a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

Bonus: Experience in travel, flights, hotels, or cars

🏥 Private Healthcare

🛩️ Duffel travel allowance (use what we build)

🧘‍♂️ Sabbatical programme (3 months full pay)

Why Now Matters

You'll work on the core API powering millions of travel bookings, with real influence over its direction. Early-stage role = outsized impact on how we build and scale, and a seat at the table for the technical decisions that will define the next phase.

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

Principal Accountabilities 

• Manage a regional portfolio of accounting firms- covering cold outbound, warm inbound, and active introducers- moving each firm through the pipeline to become a repeat client introducer.

• Build trust and credibility through a consultative approach, positioning Allica as the most recommended bank by accountants.

• Grow Allica’s presence across each firm, including multiple stakeholders, colleagues and offices, through regular regional travel and in-person meetings.

• Introduce the Business Rewards Account and other banking products to accounting firms and their clients, owning the end-to-end onboarding, funding and account usage journey.

• Qualify and introduce clients with lending needs (e.g. commercial mortgages) to the appropriate Relationship Manager.

• Act as the accounting firm’s dedicated point of contact at Allica

• Deliver and continuously improve our Accountants Playbook, ensuring firms are positively onboarded and become active, repeat introducers.

• Run regional activities - lunch and learns, roundtables and various other events

• Equip firms with an effective Partnerships Pack, marketing materials and joint initiatives to support client identification and introduction.

• Maintain accurate portfolio records in the CRM, tracking and reporting on progress to support quality and informed decision-making.

• Manage personal objectives and development plan.

• Collaborate closely across various teams at Allica to ensure a seamless, professional experience for partners and customers.

• Comply with all mandatory policies and operational procedures to maintain internal controls

Personal Attributes & Experience 

- Proven track record in B2B sales and account management

- Strong understanding of SMEs and the role of professional advisors, particularly accountants

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a track record of earning trust from partners, customers and colleagues

- Strong communication and presentation skills for in-person / virtual meetings and events

- Confident managing a CRM-based portfolio and reporting on pipeline progress

- Commercially minded, balancing new revenue generation with appropriate consideration of risk and reputation

- Comfortable working collaboratively with specialist colleagues (e.g. RMs, Marketing) to deliver good outcomes for customers and the business

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

- Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

- Discretionary bonus scheme

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start. 

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Platform Architecture and Engineering 

- Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

- Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

- Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

Platform Operations and Service Ownership  

- Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements. 

- Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes.  

- Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation. 

Team Leadership 

title: Endear - Product Designer
description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story 

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview 

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish 

In your first 6 months, you’ll… 

- Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

- Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

- Run research from early discovery through usability testing

- Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

- Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll… 

- Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

- Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

- Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

- Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

- Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If… 

- You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

- You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

- You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

- You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

- You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

- You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

- You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With 

- 2–5 years working in product design

- Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

- Running user research from discovery through usability testing

- Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

- Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

- Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

- Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

- Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

- Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

- A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value 

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

- Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

- Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

- Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

- Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

- Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team 

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

- Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

- Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

- Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process 

- Recruiter Screen

- Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

- Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

- Final leadership conversation

- Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

description:
About commercetools 

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact 

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team , you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will: 

- Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend

- Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval

- Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB

- Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it

- Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture

- Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps

- Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools

- Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart 

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

- At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM

- Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O

- Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover

- Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.

- Fluent English for work in international teams

- Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s

- Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics

- A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

- Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents

- Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.

- Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals

- Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

title: Senior Commercial Counsel
description:
Who Are We? 

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via -----
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity 

Postman's international business is growing rapidly, driven by enterprise adoption, an expanding partner ecosystem, and deepening relationships with the world's largest technology organizations across EMEA, APAC, and emerging markets. As Sr Commercial Counsel, you will be Postman's first dedicated international commercial legal hire, owning the legal work that supports this growth while operating as an extension of the US-based Commercial Legal team.

Reporting to the Managing Counsel, Commercial, you will serve as the primary legal partner for Postman's commercial and partnerships teams outside the Americas. Your manager is based in the US (New York City), and the role is designed for a high degree of autonomy during EMEA and APAC business hours, with regular touchpoints during overlapping hours to stay aligned on priorities, positions, and escalations. You will draft, negotiate, and close enterprise and mid-market SaaS agreements, partner and channel deals, and cross-border commercial transactions, with primary focus on EMEA and shared responsibility for APAC. You will also help shape how Postman's commercial legal function operates internationally, adapting US contracting standards, playbooks, and processes for global markets while maintaining consistency across the legal team. This is a high-visibility role for a commercial lawyer who wants to help build an international legal function, not just maintain one.

What You'll Do 

Commercial Contracting and Partner Support 

- Serve as lead counsel for Postman's international commercial transactions outside the Americas, with primary focus on EMEA and shared coverage of APAC enterprise and mid-market deal flow.

- Draft, review, and negotiate subscription agreements, order forms, and related deal documents with large global and mid-size enterprises on both Postman paper and counterparty paper.

- Manage a high-velocity deal pipeline spanning multiple regions and time zones, partnering directly with Sales, Deal Operations, and Finance to close complex deals at the pace the business requires.

- Apply and adapt Postman's established US contracting standards, templates, and playbooks to international transactions, ensuring global consistency while addressing local legal, regulatory, and commercial requirements.

- Advise on deal structuring, pricing models, and commercial risk across EMEA and APAC jurisdictions.

- Support the legal workstream for international partner, channel, and alliance agreements, including technology partnerships, reseller and distribution arrangements, marketplace terms, co-sell and referral terms, and co-marketing agreements.

- Contribute to the scaling of Postman's global partner program by building frameworks, templates, and processes that work across jurisdictions.

International and Cross-Border Legal Support 

- Navigate cross-border commercial issues that arise when a US-headquartered platform sells and partners internationally, including data transfer mechanisms, local regulatory considerations, and multi-entity deal structures.

- Collaborate with the US Commercial Legal team to maintain alignment on contracting positions, escalation protocols, and legal operations processes.

- Coordinate with external counsel in EMEA and APAC jurisdictions as needed for local law advice on specific transactions or regulatory questions.

- Contribute to global Legal team initiatives, including template development, process improvements, and enablement.

- Provide practical, commercially-minded guidance that enables internal stakeholders to move quickly and make informed decisions.

- Act as a resource for business teams based outside of the Americas on day-to-day commercial legal questions, building trust as an accessible and responsive legal partner.

About You 

Required Qualifications 

- Qualified solicitor or barrister in England and Wales (or equivalent UK legal qualification) in good standing.

- Law degree (LLB, JD, or equivalent).

- 7-10 years of legal experience, including substantial in-house experience at a technology company, with significant time spent on B2B enterprise and mid-market SaaS commercial transactions.

- Direct experience drafting and negotiating partner, channel, and alliance agreements, with a working understanding of technology partnership program structures, including reseller models, marketplace distribution, referral arrangements, and OEM licensing.

- Experience working on cross-border commercial transactions within a US-headquartered company's legal framework, including familiarity with US-style contracting conventions, escalation norms, and playbook-driven processes.

- Ability to work independently across EMEA and APAC time zones while maintaining close alignment with a US-based legal team on contracting standards, positions, and priorities.

- Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent transactions with speed and sound judgment, balancing risk with commercial momentum across multiple regions.

- Strong commercial instinct and the ability to translate business objectives into contract language that protects Postman while enabling deals to close.

- Clear, confident communicator who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders across time zones and functions.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Familiarity with US commercial contracting conventions and legal frameworks (formal US bar admission a plus but not required) 

- Prior in-house experience at a high-growth SaaS, developer tools, or API-focused technology company.

- Experience supporting cloud marketplace transactions or technology partnerships.

- Familiarity with AI-related commercial terms, including model-as-a-service licensing, usage-based pricing, and AI governance provisions.

- Familiarity with APAC and EMEA data protection requirements as they apply to commercial and partner agreements, including international data transfer mechanisms.

- Experience building or localizing contract templates, playbooks, or legal operations processes for new regions.

- Working knowledge of commercial legal requirements across multiple EMEA and APAC jurisdictions beyond the UK.

- Proficiency with AI tools applied to legal workflows (contract review, research, drafting, process design).

- Experience with CLM platforms (Ironclad or similar).

- Comfort with API and developer-platform concepts, with the ability to develop product fluency quickly and advise on product-adjacent commercial issues.

What Success Looks Like 

You will have established yourself as the trusted commercial legal partner for Postman's international GTM teams, with full ownership of EMEA enterprise and mid-market deal flow and established coverage of APAC commercial transactions. You will have developed a strong working cadence with the US Commercial Legal team, consistently applying Postman's global contracting standards while confidently handling jurisdiction-specific legal and regulatory considerations across both regions. You will have localized or adapted key commercial templates and playbooks for international use. Your Sales and Partner team stakeholders across EMEA and APAC will rely on you as someone who understands their deals, moves at their pace, and adds value beyond redlines. 

What Else? 

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values 

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity 

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Why you should join Fin today 

AI is transforming everything—fast. We’re at the forefront, shaping the AI Agent category and redefining customer service with Fin. Soon, Fin will handle the vast majority of customer interactions, setting a new standard for support.

This shift isn’t just changing what we build—it’s changing how we work. Our team is constantly evolving, integrating AI into design, development, and go-to-market strategies.

At Fin, design is in our DNA. With 60+ designers across R&D and Brand and two co-founders from design, you’ll never have to fight for your place at the table.

Here, designers lead from the start, shaping products that millions of people interact with daily. If you want to work on cutting-edge AI experiences that push the boundaries of product design, there’s no better place to be.

Why this role exists 

In a world where it’s easier and easier to get software off the ground and to 75% built, it’s the last 25% that really matters. We need deep craft specialists—people who will raise the quality bar, bring a spark of creativity, drive best-in-class interaction and visual design, and push execution excellence across our most strategic product areas.

This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. We need a maker, a doer, a leader in craft.

If you have a deep passion for interaction design, product thinking, and pixel-perfect execution—and the leadership and autonomy to drive impact without waiting for direction—this is the role for you.

Must Have Experience 

We’re looking for a world-class IC designer who:

- Has shipped complex, high-quality software products.

- Designs for multiple surfaces—desktop, mobile, chat interfaces, AI first and emerging experiences.

- Balances speed and detail—knows when to move fast and when to obsess over the last 1%.

- Thinks end-to-end—from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction detail.

- Understands engineering and can build prototypes to communicate ideas (Framer, Loveable, Windsurf, Vercel, Figma, code etc...).

- Has taste. You know what great design looks and feels like, and you push to get there.

- Can tell a compelling story—articulating your decisions with clarity and conviction.

- Operates with agency, ownership, and autonomy—doesn’t wait to be told what to do.

Who This Role Is Not For 

This role is not for you if: 
● You prefer strategy, research or system design over execution—this is a craft-heavy role. 
● You need a lot of direction or structured processes—you should thrive in open-endedness and ambiguity. 
● You don’t obsess over details—we’re looking for someone who sweats the pixels. 
● You primarily work on marketing sites—this role is about designing deep, functional software experiences.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

What you’ll be doing: 
● Owning end-to-end design for high-impact product areas from concept to execution. 
● Defining new interaction patterns and design paradigms for Fin, our automation, and AI-powered tools. 
● Sketching, prototyping, and testing ideas at different fidelities to validate decisions. 
● Working closely with engineers and PMs to define problems, move quickly, and deliver high-quality solutions. 
● Maintaining high standards of craft while balancing speed and execution. 
● Contributing to design culture—mentoring others, pushing for greatness in a team, refining processes, and sharing knowledge inside and outside Fin.

What Success Looks Like 

You’ll know you’re successful if: 
1. You’ve raised the design bar. Your work is referenced as an example of exceptional craft and taste. 
2. You’ve shipped product with major business impact. The areas you own are visibly better because of you. 
3. You operate autonomously. You don’t need direction—you see what needs to be done and do it. 
4. Engineers love working with you. Your designs are considered, clear, and easy to implement. 
5. Your peers trust your judgment. When you push for quality, people listen.

Interview Process 

We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time and energy consuming–we aim to be thorough, speedy and transparent in our approach. You should expect for the entire 
process to be no more than 4 weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with various members of our team and have the opportunity to fully validate that Fin and the role is the right fit 
for you.

Ready to build something great? 

If you're driven to push the boundaries of product design and have the craft, autonomy, and taste to make a real impact, we want to hear from you. 

Unleash Your Potential 

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. title: Account Director, Digital Natives - France
description:
About the team 

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role 

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you'll: 

- Manage ~dozen key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

- Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to succesful deployment

- Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

- Own a consumption revenue target

- Manage consumption revenue forecasts

- Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders

- Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

- Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

- Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

- Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including: 

- 5-7+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service

- Achieving revenue targets >$1M per year for more than 3 years

- Designing and executing complex deal strategies

- Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies

- Working directly with c-level executives

- Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders

- Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.)

- Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

You might thrive in this role if you: 

- Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

- Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

- Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

- Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

- Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

About OpenAI 

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. About the role... 

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

- Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

- One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

- One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

- Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

- Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

- Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

- Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

- Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

- Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

- Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

- Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

- Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

- Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

- A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

- Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

- Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

- Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

- Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

Who you are... 

- Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

- The four partnership managers have clear mandates, partner ICPs, account priorities and measurable pipeline objectives.

You will own a strategic growth engine across France and Spain and shape how Airwallex builds channel-led growth in the region.

- Director-level ownership across two European markets

- Strategic and hands-on player-coach role

- Direct ownership of partner-sourced growth and strategic partnerships

title: DPO & Compliance Officer
description:
🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

- Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

- Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

- Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

- Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

- Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

- Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

- Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

- Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

- Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

- Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

- For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

- For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

- 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

- Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

- Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

- Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

- Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

- Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

- Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

- Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

- Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

- Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

- Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

- Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

- Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. 

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe 

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work 

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us 

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits 

- Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

- Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

- Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

- Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture. 

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 
The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 

addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world. 

What you’ll do: 

- Deliver major features and architectural improvements across the Add-ons stack, including automated moderation pipelines, Reviewer tools, and DevHub. 

- Help establish and maintain engineering standards across areas such as code review, definition of done, production readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call practices, coding conventions, and infrastructure as code. 

- Create robust observability systems and data-backed insights. 

- Provide peer feedback, share knowledge and help others grow. 

- Build and improve the systems that enable Add-ons engineering to safely develop, deploy, observe, and operate production services. 

- Improve our CI/CD pipelines using declarative, pipeline-as-code approaches that make changes reproducible, testable, and easy to review. 

- Deliver work iteratively using a visible backlog, short feedback cycles, retrospectives, and demonstrations to stakeholders. 

- Write clear technical documentation, including design notes, Architecture Decision Records, runbooks, and incident write-ups. 

- Work effectively in unfamiliar codebases, tracing requests and asynchronous jobs end-to-end to understand failures and identify opportunities for improvement. 

- Collaborate with designers, product managers, QA, and community contributors to deliver end-to-end improvements. 

- Contribute in the open through pull requests, code reviews, and discussions. 

- Work on: 

- Feature development: submission flows, trust and safety signals, DevHub and Reviewer tools modernization. 

- AMO application systems: Work within our Python/Django, MySQL, React/TypeScript, and asynchronous processing systems. 

- Internal developer platforms : Create tools and paved paths that make it easier for teams to ship and operate software safely and consistently. 

- Team Process: Contribute to team ceremonies, execute process improvement, and provide feedback on team effectiveness. 

- Engineering standards : Help make production readiness, testing, recoverability, documentation, and safe deployment part of the normal development lifecycle. 

- Platform reliability: Deployments, monitoring, and incident response. 

What you’ll bring: 

- Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications with Python/Django. 

- Experience operating and improving production software systems where reliability and safe delivery matter. 

- Strong experience with CI/CD systems and treating pipelines and infrastructure declaratively as code. 

- Experience designing or improving automated testing and deployment workflows, including integration testing and staged or progressive delivery. 

- Strong understanding of observability as an engineering discipline, including metrics, logging, tracing, service-level objectives, and actionable alerting. 

- Experience building or maintaining internal tools or platforms used by other engineering teams, with an understanding that internal systems have users, reliability expectations, roadmaps, and lifecycle considerations. 

- Experience defining or improving engineering practices such as code review standards, operational readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call expectations, or definitions of done. 

- Ability to read and understand unfamiliar codebases and trace application behavior across frontend, backend, asynchronous jobs, data stores, and infrastructure. 

- Experience debugging complex production issues and turning what you learn into lasting system improvements. 

- Strong technical writing skills, with experience creating useful documentation such as design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and incident reports. 

- Experience working iteratively with a visible backlog, regular stakeholder feedback, and retrospectives that result in concrete improvements. 

- Strong collaboration and communication skills in a distributed team environment. 

- A willingness to share knowledge and mentor peers in operational and reliability practices. 

- Commitment to our values: 

- Welcoming differences 

- Being relationship-minded 

- Practicing responsible participation 

- Having grit 

Bonus points for: 

- Experience with Google Cloud and operating Kubernetes. 

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and policy-as-code. 

- Experience establishing SLOs and error-budget-based reliability practices. 

- Experience with chaos engineering, disaster recovery testing, or production readiness reviews. 

- Experience with trust and safety, automated moderation, abuse prevention, or other adversarial systems. 

- Contributions to open source projects 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Quarterly well-being stipend 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

Pour plus d’informations, visitez   www.wpp.com .

Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com .  

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

- Un compte leader et iconique du secteur de la restauration rapide, caractérisé par des campagnes 360° puissantes et très visibles (TV, Affichage, Vidéo, Digital, Opérations Spéciales, Data). 

- Un compte international en forte croissance dans l'univers Tech / Fintech , évoluant dans un environnement digitalisé, dynamique et réactif. 

- Le développement et l'accompagnement de nouveaux projets stratégiques  et opportunités au sein du groupe.

- Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et annuelles pour les marques du portefeuille en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°. 

- Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés. 

- Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.

- Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment :  Influence & Content / Opérations Spéciales, Retail Media & E-Commerce, GEO / Proximité, Data et IA / LLM .

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone. 

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

- Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

- Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

- 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

- ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

- 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

- 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.
