title: Software Architect
description:
Job Requisition ID # 

26WD94957

Position Overview 

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. 

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. 

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. 

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. 

Responsibilities 

- API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. 

- System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. 

- Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. 

- Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. 

- Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. 

- Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. 

- Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

- Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. 

Minimum Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 

- 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. 

- Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). 

- Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

- Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

- Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

- Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

- Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

- Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

- Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

- API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

- Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

- Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

- Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

- BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

- AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

- Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

- Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

- AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

- Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

- Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

- Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. 

- Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. 

- Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. 

Learn More 

About Autodesk 

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency 

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging 
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

title: Senior Technical Integration Specialist
description:
The Senior Technical Integration Specialist plays a pivotal part in onboarding new practices’ clinical data, new payers' claims data, and managing technical implementation projects with healthcare vendors. The Sr. Technical Integration Specialist is responsible for supporting data integration efforts, managing system deployments, and ensuring successful go-live of AI and data-driven solutions in a complex healthcare environment. 

What you'll be doing

- Acting as the technical point of contact for both external and internal stakeholders during the onboarding and implementation process. 

- Managing, coordinating, and executing data integration and tech integration projects, including EMR integrations, third-party vendor integrations, data retrievals, API connections, and SFTP data feeds with vendors.

- Facilitating conversations between internal and external tech and business stakeholders, designing, documenting and presenting data flow diagrams, and project managing integrations to ensure successful and smooth delivery of the end results. 

- Translating clinical and operational requirements into technical configurations and workflows. 

- Creating and maintaining integration documentation including technical specifications, workflow and processes diagrams, implementation guides, and SOPs. 

- Performing data QA and validation activities, including executing scripts and manual checks for data format, completeness, and accuracy. 

- Troubleshooting and resolving integration issues, coordinating with engineering, vendor, or client teams as needed. 

- Managing go-live planning, execution, maintenance and provide post-implementation support. 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS

- Bachelor’s degree in quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, Statistics, or equivalent experience.

- 3+ years of experience in a technical implementation, data integration, or data analytics in the healthcare industry.

- Working knowledge of healthcare data formats and standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, CCDA, XML, JSON) 

- Familiarity with clinical vocabularies and coding systems (e.g., CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED, NPI, RXNORM).

- Extensive experience working with data and technical integration projects that includes ETL pipeline, data normalization/processing, SFTP, and API connections

- Proficiency with cross-team project tracking/documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence

- Experience with data QA and validation processes.

- Familiarity in SQL, Python, and Bash for data querying and script execution

- Proven experience in leading technical implementation projects in healthcare, including client or vendor onboarding.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS (S3, Lambda, Step Functions), GCP, or Azure.

- Understanding of healthcare workflows (e.g., care management, risk adjustment, quality improvement, revenue cycle, prior authorizations, value-based care).

- Strong communication and presentation skills for interfacing with clinical and technical stakeholders.

- Fluency in SQL

- Familiarity with the Arcadia Analytics Foundry database schema

title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform and Cloud Services
description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft ’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview 

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft 's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

- Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain

- Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations

- Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.

- Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

- Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.

- Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.

- Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.

- Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

- Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.

- Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.

- Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

- Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem

- Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.

- Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.

- Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.

- Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.

- Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

API DESIGN

- Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.

- Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

- Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own

- Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default

- Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.

- Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers

- Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

- Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.

title: Vice President, Payer Growth
description:
About MedeAnalytics 

MedeAnalytics is the Enterprise Healthcare Performance company that delivers AI-driven, cloud-native solutions to help payers, risk-bearing providers and other value- and risk-bearing entities measurably improve performance by reducing costs, improving quality and MLR, optimizing utilization, increasing reimbursement, and elevating care quality across all lines of business. Its enterprise health data management platform—built on its proprietary Health Fabric™—unifies clinical, claims, financial, and social data into a single, scalable source of truth that fuels insights, action, and AI. 

As the industry’s healthcare intelligence partner of choice for more than 30 years, MedeAnalytics combines its platform, cross-domain enterprise analytics, AI-powered workflows, and Strategic Advisory™ services to transform intelligence into accountable execution—delivering greater ROI across value-based care, risk and quality, cost and utilization management, and network optimization. 

MedeAnalytics empowers organizations to move faster from insight to impact with confidence and measurable results. To learn more, visit  medeanalytics.com  and follow MedeAnalytics on  LinkedIn and Facebook . 

About Our Opportunity

Core Requirement

This role requires a proven strategic payer sales leader with demonstrated success selling and expanding enterprise solutions with health plans, primary focus in Medicare Advantage and Medicaid, secondarily in Commercial markets. The ideal candidate understands the distinct business, regulatory, operational, and market dynamics of each line of business and can translate payer priorities into credible executive-level strategies that drive measurable growth.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Payer Growth is responsible for generating new business and expanding strategic health plan relationships within an assigned territory and account portfolio. This leader will develop territory and account strategies, build trusted relationships with payer executives, identify and quantify whitespace, and lead complex enterprise sales opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution.

A key focus of the role is creating a comprehensive growth strategy for an existing portfolio of health plan clients, meaning accelerate cross-sell opportunities; and pursuing new logo opportunities with national, regional, State sponsored, and other risk-bearing payers.

The successful candidate will connect payer priorities—including affordability, healthcare economics, risk and quality performance, value-based care, population health, member engagement, customer and group reporting, AI, and enterprise data strategy to the MedeAnalytics Health Performance Platform and broader solution portfolio. This individual must be equally effective as an enterprise seller, strategic account leader, healthcare advisor, and cross-functional team orchestrator.

Key Responsibilities

New Business and Revenue Growth

- Develop and execute a territory growth strategy across Medicare Advantage and Medicaid.

- Build and manage a qualified pipeline through executive relationships, market intelligence, targeted prospecting, partnerships, and industry engagement.

- Create account-specific strategies for priority health plans, including relationship maps, business hypotheses, solution alignment, and pursuit plans.

- Lead consultative conversations that connect payer business priorities to MedeAnalytics ' data, analytics, AI, workflow, and advisory capabilities.

- Manage complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and solution development through executive presentations, RFPs, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

- Consistently achieve or exceed annual new-logo, expansion, ARR, and revenue targets.

Strategic Account Expansion

- Serve as the commercial growth leader for an assigned portfolio of existing health plan clients.

- Partner with Account Management to develop and execute strategic growth and success plans for each priority account.

- Build a deep understanding of each client's strategy, operating model, technology and analytics environment, financial objectives, transformation initiatives, and competitive landscape.

- Identify and quantify whitespace across the MedeAnalytics portfolio and convert it into actionable near- and long-term opportunities.

- Expand relationships beyond current users and buyers by developing executive sponsorship across business, clinical, financial, technology, analytics, and operational functions.

- Lead the commercial strategy for expansions, cross-sells, and upsells, positioning MedeAnalytics as a long-term enterprise partner.

- Coordinate executive sponsorship and internal resources around the highest-value growth opportunities.

Territory and Market Leadership

- Maintain a comprehensive territory plan covering current clients, priority prospects, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and revenue potential.

- Apply a strong understanding of the distinct priorities of Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, dual-eligible, and commercial health plans to shape relevant executive conversations and growth strategies.

- Monitor payer trends, policy changes, competitive activity, and emerging client needs, translating market intelligence into commercial opportunities.

- Represent MedeAnalytics at industry conferences, client events, executive meetings, and other payer forums.

- Establish MedeAnalytics as a strategic thought partner—not solely a technology or analytics vendor—with health plan leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Operating Discipline 

- Serve as the commercial lead for assigned strategic accounts, coordinating Account Management, Product, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Services, Partnerships, and executive leadership.

- Translate client needs and market intelligence into actionable input for product strategy, partnerships, messaging, and go-to-market priorities.

- Collaborate with solution and product leaders to develop compelling business cases tied to measurable clinical, financial, operational, and member outcomes.

- Lead regular account and territory reviews focused on pipeline, client health, revenue risk, whitespace, relationship coverage, and next actions.

- Maintain disciplined opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, and CRM hygiene.

Measures of Success

- New-logo ARR and revenue

- Expansion ARR and revenue from existing clients

- Qualified pipeline creation, progression, and conversion

- Growth of MedeAnalytics ' footprint within strategic accounts

- Executive relationship depth and breadth

- Strategic account and territory plan execution

- Forecast accuracy

- Client advocacy and referenceability

- Achievement of annual territory revenue objectives

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

- 10+ years of successful enterprise sales, strategic account growth, or business development experience in healthcare technology, analytics, SaaS, consulting, or related solutions serving health plans.

- Demonstrated sales and account-expansion success across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan markets .

- Strong understanding of the distinct economics, regulatory requirements, operating models, purchasing dynamics, and strategic priorities of government-sponsored and commercial health plans.

- Proven ability to originate, develop, and close complex, multi-million-dollar enterprise opportunities.

- Experience developing and expanding relationships with large national, regional, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and/or provider-sponsored health plans.

- Strong understanding of payer priorities, including affordability, medical cost management, value-based care, risk adjustment, quality, population health, network performance, member engagement, and enterprise analytics.

- Working knowledge of healthcare data, including medical and pharmacy claims, clinical, financial, eligibility, provider, and social risk data.

- Ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executives across business, clinical, financial, operational, technology, and analytics functions.

- Experience navigating complex RFPs, procurement processes, contracting, and enterprise decision-making environments.

- Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.

- Highly self-directed, with the discipline to manage a large territory and portfolio of complex strategic accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

- Established executive relationships within the U.S. payer market.

- Experience selling enterprise healthcare data platforms, analytics, AI, population health, value-based care, quality, risk, or financial performance solutions.

- Understanding of modern healthcare data architecture, cloud platforms, interoperability, AI/ML, and enterprise analytics environments.

- Experience helping health plans unify fragmented data and analytics environments or expand enterprise adoption of a strategic platform.

- Demonstrated payer-market thought leadership and the ability to represent MedeAnalytics credibly with senior industry executives.

Leadership Profile

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial ownership, strategic thinking, and executive relationship-building skills to manage their territory and account portfolio as a trusted partner to health plan leaders.

MedeAnalytics believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 USD + commission opportunities. Please note that actual compensation for all roles may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, relevant work experience, professional achievements/qualifications, skill level, business need, location and will be finalized at the time of offer.

401(k) Plan with company match

Professional Development Opportunities to support your growth

Overview

LMI is seeking an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer to support a Special Operations Command (SOCOM) mission partner with production machine learning, predictive forecasting, natural language processing, generative AI, and real-time decision-support capabilities. The AI/ML Engineer will design, implement, optimize, integrate, and sustain scalable AI/ML solutions within secure web-based applications and enterprise workflows. This position will work as part of a cross-functional data science product team to translate validated models into reliable operational capabilities while advancing reusable engineering patterns, governance, security, documentation, and enterprise AI/ML best practices.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and achieve mission success.

This position requires an active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, test, and optimize machine learning algorithms for predictive forecasting, rate prediction, resource planning, and real-time decision support.

- Develop and refine supervised, unsupervised, time-series, regression, ensemble, and other appropriate models to meet stringent accuracy, reliability, explainability, latency, and efficiency requirements.

- Develop natural language processing and generative AI solutions, including large language models and retrieval-augmented generation capabilities tailored to approved business, operational, and intelligence use cases.

- Engineer reusable model services, application programming interfaces, containers, and software components that integrate seamlessly into secure web-based applications, dashboards, and other mission data products.

- Design scalable and reliable architectures for batch and real-time inference, model serving, monitoring, and application support across development, test, and production environments.

- Integrate predictive models into existing web-based applications and enterprise workflows while ensuring compatibility, reliability, security, and seamless user functionality.

- Collaborate with data scientists and data engineers to establish compatible data structures, features, pipelines, interfaces, and validation methods for model training, evaluation, deployment, and sustainment.

- Conduct performance testing, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, back-testing, drift detection, and model monitoring; document assumptions, limitations, risks, and opportunities for continued improvement.

- Implement MLOps and DevSecOps practices for source control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and repeatable sustainment.

- Apply responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.

- Support enterprise synchronization, integration, governance, sustainment, and adoption of AI/ML capabilities across multiple mission teams, stakeholder organizations, applications, and products.

- Develop projects that automate or augment human cognitive workload and respond rapidly to emerging operational requirements and changes in the mission environment.

- Produce and maintain technical documentation covering algorithms, system architecture, interfaces, security, testing, deployment, operations, and integration processes.

- Develop user guides, training materials, demonstrations, instructional videos, and knowledge-transfer products sufficient for a qualified practitioner to assume future operation and sustainment of the capability.

- Provide rapid-response engineering and product-level staff augmentation based on changes in mission priorities and the operational environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field.

- Five or more years of professional experience designing, developing, deploying, and sustaining machine learning models or AI-enabled software capabilities in production environments.

- Advanced proficiency with Python and practical experience with modern machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable technologies.

- Demonstrated experience developing and validating predictive models, including time-series, regression, ensemble, or comparable forecasting methods, against defined accuracy and performance requirements.

- Experience operationalizing models through application programming interfaces, services, containers, automated testing, version control, continuous integration and delivery, model registries, monitoring, and repeatable deployment processes.

- Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, feature pipelines, data quality controls, and secure integration with relational, non-relational, object-storage, or analytical data platforms.

- Experience developing scalable architectures for batch or real-time inference, model serving, application integration, monitoring, and production support.

- Knowledge of responsible and secure AI/ML engineering practices, including access control, data protection, model governance, explainability, evaluation, auditability, and risk management.

- Experience producing clear algorithm, architecture, interface, test, deployment, operational, and knowledge-transfer documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across data science, data engineering, software, cybersecurity, governance, and operational teams.

- Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable production capabilities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field.

- Experience with secure government cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud or Azure Government and with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, or comparable production delivery practices.

- Prior military service or direct professional experience supporting U.S. Special Operations Forces.

Target Competencies

- Mission Focus

- Systems Engineering

- Product Ownership

- Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

- Clear Communication

- Adaptability and Continuous Learning

title: Director of Product Line Management (US - Remote)
description:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience. 

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers. 

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam. 

We are seeking a Director of Product Line Management to define, build, and scale a portfolio of telecom enterprise services and network products. This leader will own the strategy and business performance of offerings that enable enterprises and service providers to connect locations reliably, securely, and at scale - from access devices and Layer 2 switching platforms to Carrier Ethernet and managed connectivity services.

Operating as the general manager for the product line, the Director will translate customer and market requirements into differentiated architectures, investment priorities, roadmaps, launch plans, and lifecycle decisions. The ideal candidate has brought purpose-built products - such as Layer 2 switches, Ethernet NIDs/eNIDs, access platforms, or edge appliances - from concept through certification, scale, and end-of-life, and understands how those platforms become repeatable, SLA-backed services.

What You'll Own

- Portfolio strategy and P&L: Set the multi-year strategy, market segmentation, investment thesis, pricing, packaging, revenue plan, margin targets, and portfolio rationalization decisions using customer and competitive insight.

- Product creation: Lead the end-to-end development of Layer 2 switching, Carrier Ethernet demarcation, NID/eNID, access, and edge products, including market requirements, business cases, PRDs, platform choices, feature priorities, release criteria, and lifecycle plans.

- Enterprise service portfolio: Build scalable services including Ethernet Private Line and Virtual Private Line, E-LAN, DIA access, managed LAN, cloud connectivity, and adjacent secure or assured connectivity offers.

- Technical and platform direction: Partner with Engineering and Architecture on switching silicon, system architecture, network operating software, optics, timing, power, thermal, security, manageability, and service-assurance requirements.

- Partner and supply ecosystem: Evaluate and manage chipset, ODM/JDM, contract manufacturing, optics, software, certification, and technology partners; balance cost, differentiation, quality, availability, and roadmap control.

- Product lifecycle governance: Establish disciplined stage gates from discovery and concept through development, field trials, launch, sustaining engineering, refresh, migration, and end-of-sale/end-of-support.

- Go-to-market leadership: Define positioning, competitive differentiation, sales plays, solution bundles, enablement, launch readiness, reference customers, and adoption programs with Sales and Marketing.

- Operational readiness: Ensure products and services are deployable, observable, supportable, and automatable through OSS/BSS, inventory, orchestration, telemetry, assurance, and zero-touch provisioning capabilities.

- Team leadership: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing product line management team; create clear decision rights, operating rhythms, accountability, and succession plans.

Domain Expertise

Candidates with demonstrated depth across several of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

- Layer 2 switching: Ethernet switching architectures; VLANs and IEEE 802.1Q; QinQ/802.1ad; LAG and MC-LAG; STP/RSTP/MSTP; LLDP; QoS, buffering, multicast, and resiliency.

- Carrier Ethernet and MEF services: E-Line/E-LAN/E-Tree service constructs, EPL/EVPL, bandwidth profiles, class of service, service OAM, SLA design, UNI/NNI concepts, and MEF-aligned lifecycle automation.

- Network demarcation and access: NIDs/eNIDs, CPE/uCPE, fixed and mobile access, multi-rate GbE interfaces, optics, synchronization, timing, and carrier-grade deployment considerations.

- Hardware and software platforms: Merchant silicon and SDK ecosystems, BSPs, embedded systems, network operating systems, APIs, telemetry, secure boot, software maintenance, component lifecycle, and supply-chain risk.

- Service assurance and automation: IEEE 802.1ag CFM, ITU-T Y.1731, performance monitoring, fault isolation, zero-touch provisioning, streaming telemetry, orchestration, inventory, and closed-loop assurance.

- Commercial product management: Market sizing, competitive analysis, portfolio economics, pricing, gross margin, unit cost, forecasting, business cases, channel strategy, and contract or SLA implications.

What You Bring

- Experience: 12+ years in product management or product line leadership in telecom, networking, or enterprise connectivity, including 5+ years leading teams or major portfolios.

- Proven product delivery: A record of launching and scaling physical networking products such as Layer 2 switches, NIDs/eNIDs, access devices, routers, or edge appliances, together with software and service capabilities.

- Business ownership: Demonstrated responsibility for a product line business plan, revenue and margin performance, pricing, roadmap investment, and lifecycle decisions.

- Technical fluency: Ability to engage credibly with system architects and engineers on hardware, silicon, NOS/software, optics, protocols, APIs, telemetry, and deployment tradeoffs without losing sight of customer and commercial outcomes.

- Market leadership: Strong understanding of enterprise buyer needs, telecom operator economics, global competitive dynamics, routes to market, and standards-based service delivery.

- Cross-functional influence: Success aligning Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and external partners around high-stakes product decisions.

- Executive influence: Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, align senior stakeholders, and drive decisions.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

How Success Will Be Measured

- Growth and economics: Revenue, bookings, adoption, strategic account penetration, gross margin, forecast accuracy, inventory health, and return on product investment.

- Execution: Roadmap predictability, on-time launch, quality, certification readiness, field-trial conversion, and lifecycle discipline.

- Customer outcomes: Service availability, SLA performance, deployment velocity, support burden, customer satisfaction, and renewal/expansion.

- Leadership: Team capability, decision quality, cross-functional alignment, and development of future product leaders.

Why Join Us

- Build the portfolio: Shape the next generation of enterprise connectivity products and services from architecture through commercial scale.

- Work across the stack: Unite hardware, software, automation, assurance, and managed services to solve real connectivity problems.

- Lead with autonomy: Join an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed organization that values sound judgment, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

Working Conditions

This is a full-time leadership position operating in a professional office and remote collaboration environment. The role requires flexibility to work across global time zones and to support important customer, partner, launch, or operational matters outside standard business hours when reasonably necessary.

Travel and Physical Requirements

Ability to travel domestically and internationally, typically up to 25-35%, with a valid passport and no material travel restrictions. The role requires extended computer use and periodic visits to offices, laboratories, manufacturing partners, data centers, and customer network sites.

Annual salary range: $220,000 - $320,000

title: Senior Product Manager, Cluster Linking
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Ontario, Canada

We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About the Role: 

Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.

This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.

Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.

What You Will Do: 

- Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.

- Define the future of real-time stream sharing across organizations, including its security model, networking, access controls, and how it scales across organizations and use cases.

- Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.

- Segment and re-package Cluster Linking. The product serves Disaster Recovery, migrations, data sharing, and cross-cloud replication, each with different customer needs and pricing dynamics. Define how we package, price, and position each so the offering works for customers and drives growth.

- Partner closely with your engineering manager counterpart as a strategic partner. Use that partnership to understand tradeoffs, make decisions fast, and keep the product moving forward.

- Work directly with customers. You'll be pulled in many directions, customers will ask a lot of you. Your job is to steer them toward the right architectures and models, get them excited about what's coming, listen to what they need next, and balance the present opportunity with where the product is headed.

- Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.

- Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.

What You Will Bring: 

- 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in infrastructure, data platforms, or cloud products. You've shipped technical products and driven measurable outcomes.

- Genuine interest in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. Kafka is not simple. You don't need prior Kafka expertise, but you need to be energized by technical depth, not put off by it.

- A results-driven mindset. You don't wait for things to happen, you make them happen. You get on calls with sellers, you pull in the right people, and you keep pushing until the work is done.

- Proven ability to influence. You get people excited and aligned, across engineering, field, sales, finance, and leadership, often without formal authority.

- Strong ownership mentality. You take responsibility from day one. You drive ambiguous problems to clarity, remove blockers, and treat the product like your own business.

- Business thinking beyond the backlog. You think about segmentation, packaging, pricing, and market impact, not just features. You understand that how a product is offered matters as much as what it does.

- Clear communication. You can make technical topics understandable for executive audiences, write sharp product docs, and present confidently to customers and leadership.

- LLM or GenAI knowledge is a bonus, but not required

Ready to build what's next? Let’s get in motion. 

Come As You Are 

Belonging isn’t a perk here. It’s the baseline. We work across time zones and backgrounds, knowing the best ideas come from different perspectives. And we make space for everyone to lead, grow, and challenge what’s possible.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment decisions are based on job-related criteria, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by law.

As Zowie grows and brings larger enterprise customers onto our AI platform, we’re facing challenges that sit at the intersection of infrastructure, application architecture, developer experience, and enterprise clients’ requirements. These problems are rarely well-defined upfront, there’s never a single way to solve them and they can’t be solved by tooling alone. 

This is why we’re looking for an energetic DevOps/Platform Engineer , who enjoys building usable and reliable platform capabilities — from first understanding why the problem exists, through design and implementation, to long-term ownership in production. 

Several factors shape the nature of platform work here... 

What makes platform challenges interesting at Zowie:

- Enterprise readiness – secure access patterns, auditability, and compliance are becoming first-class requirements.
- Multi-cloud reality – AWS is our primary environment today, with GCP playing a growing role.
- Mission-critical workloads – our platform sits on the frontline of our customers’ businesses, so reliability, clarity, and operational ownership matter.
- Developer enablement at scale – as the organization grows, platform decisions increasingly affect developers velocity, and our mission is to enable them for success.
- Technological variety - to support the Product team's needs, our infrastructure consists of many technologies, like MongoDB, Postgres, ElasticSearch, Cassandra and Redis.
- Voice Technologies - as our AI Agent supports phone calls, you’ll have a chance to work with reliable and scalable SIP infrastructure.

This role might be for you, if you:

- Want to have real influence on how an entire platform evolves
- Enjoy owning initiatives end-to-end, not just implementing predefined tasks
- Are curious to understand your stakeholders, then design pragmatic solutions that account for the impact of your decisions
- Like working at the boundary between infrastructure, application architecture, and developer experience

What you'll do:

- Work with AWS and GCP infrastructure (IaC, networking, compute, IAM, secrets), secure access and authorization mechanisms (DB auth, IAM flows, audit).
- Communicate with various stakeholders to understand different infrastructure-related challenges, provide solution plans and ensure success of the initiatives you own.
- Collaborate closely with developers to understand their workflows, pain points, and constraints; ensure platform decisions improve developer experience.

Ideally, you'll bring with you:

- 2+ years in DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering roles
- Experience with GCP or AWS (IAM, networking, compute, storage, common managed services)
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code in a multi-datacenter/multi-cloud deployment setup
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic can-do attitude
- High degree of ownership and desire to drive projects from start to finish
- Good familiarity with CI/CD processes and approaches

It will be awesome if you also have:

- Experience with visualization tools like Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus
- Experience with storage tech like MongoDB, Postgres, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch
- Experience managing AWS costs, running backup recovery operations
- Experience with SaaS/enterprise customers (security reviews, compliance expectations)

AI-native culture: 

Our team embraces AI as a fundamental part of how we work - not just for speed, but for creativity, documentation, and scale. We’re looking for people who are excited to develop within this space and contribute to such culture by bringing ideas to the table, and continuously evolving their approach to leverage emerging tools.

title: Senior Product Designer, Mobile Experience
description:
Headquarters: Remote (AU)

HappyCo is a company where people can grow their careers and work with like minded people, with no egos or politics. HappyCo is values driven and offers a flexible, supportive culture. Join HappyCo and Make Work Happy ! 

Sitting within HappyCo’s mobile product team, the Senior Product Designer, Mobile Experience focuses on the tools frontline property teams use every day to conduct inspections, complete preventive maintenance, resolve work orders, and capture high‑quality property data directly from the field. These experiences must work under pressure, in poor connectivity, and with little tolerance for friction.

You will own complex mobile workflows end to end — from discovery through delivery and beyond launch — working as part of a product triad alongside the team’s Product Manager and Engineering Lead. Together, you will help define the team’s roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs in alignment with company goals, product strategy, and long-term vision. Within this triad, you will be responsible for shaping how emerging technologies, particularly AI‑powered experiences, reduce effort, improve accuracy, and accelerate outcomes for frontline users and the businesses they support. The work requires high autonomy, speed, and a willingness to break down silos across product areas to deliver cohesive, scalable experiences.

The role suits a designer who demonstrates high‑impact judgment and broad ownership, operating independently regardless of title or formal level. It calls for comfort with experimentation, thoughtful use of AI to increase both user value and internal efficiency, and a day‑to‑day commitment to customer obsession.

With direct access to thousands of daily mobile users, success depends on turning customer exposure into visible, actionable insight and regularly sharing patterns and outcomes with teams across HappyCo to inform decisions beyond the mobile surface.

What You'll Do | Design Ownership & Impact

- Own and evolve core mobile workflows used daily by maintenance and property teams in the field.
- Co-author and articulate a clear mobile product experience vision in partnership with Product Management and Design Leadership, and act as a long-term champion for that vision as the product evolves.
- Design for real-world constraints: offline usage, unreliable connectivity, performance limitations, device variability, and speed under pressure.
- Identify and drive improvements across product boundaries, not just within a single product team or feature.
- Translate complex operational problems into simple, resilient, mobile-first solutions.

What You'll Do | Customer Obsession

- Develop a deep understanding of how maintenance technicians, asset managers, and property managers actually work, rather than how we assume they work.
- Run timely, pragmatic research including interviews, usability testing, and lightweight validation loops.
- Bring real customer context, such as quotes, workflows, edge cases, and observed behaviours, into everyday product discussions.
- Balance customer needs with business goals, technical constraints, and operational realities.
- Challenge solutions that are technically impressive or user-friendly in isolation but misaligned with business outcomes or strategic priorities.

What You'll Do | Design Execution & Speed

- Design, prototype, test, and iterate quickly using high-fidelity mobile prototypes.
- Leverage AI-driven tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, validation, synthesis, and delivery as part of your daily workflow.
- Balance speed with judgment, delivering work that is high quality, scalable, and grounded in evidence.
- Deliver meaningful customer-facing improvements within your first month.

What You'll Do | Product Signals & Insight

- Own the design perspective on mobile product instrumentation, ensuring key workflows are measurable and observable.
- Partner with Product and Engineering to define meaningful mobile UX metrics (e.g. task completion, time-on-task, drop-offs, retries, adoption).
- Regularly monitor and analyze product usage data to identify patterns, friction points, and emerging behaviours.
- Translate insights into clear hypotheses and concrete design actions.
- Validate whether shipped changes improve outcomes and iterate based on evidence.

What You'll Do | Making Customer Insight Visible

- Regularly synthesize and share customer insights from mobile usage data, research, and field feedback with the design team, product partners, and the wider organization.
- Surface patterns and themes, not just isolated findings, to keep teams grounded in real customer needs.
- Act as a strong, evidence-backed voice for the customer in cross-functional conversations.
- Create lightweight, repeatable ways for teams to stay close to mobile customers, even when they are not directly involved in the work.
- Use insights to influence priorities and follow-up actions.

What You'll Do | Collaboration, Craft & Culture

- Partner closely with Product Managers and Mobile Engineers to define scope, navigate trade-offs, and deliver outcomes.
- Work closely with Design Leadership to shape and evolve the mobile product experience vision, aligning day-to-day execution with longer-term direction.
- Bring clarity to ambiguity and momentum to complex or stalled problem spaces.
- Contribute to and strengthen HappyCo’s mobile design system, based on Material 3 and extended through a custom HappyCo theme.
- Participate actively in Product Design team critiques and formal UX reviews, offering and receiving direct, high-signal feedback.
- Help raise the bar for design quality, speed, and customer focus across the team.

What You Bring

- Typically 8–10+ years of experience in product design, or equivalent demonstrated impact owning complex, real-world products.
- Strong product instincts and high personal standards for quality, outcomes, and pace.
- Proven experience owning end-to-end mobile product design in complex, real-world environments.
- A portfolio that demonstrates depth of thinking, clear problem framing, and measurable impact.
- Comfort operating with ambiguity and taking initiative without waiting for permission.
- A demonstrated habit of monitoring your work after launch and acting on what you learn.
- Ability to plan and run lightweight user research independently, including interviews, usability testing, and rapid feedback loops.
- Good judgment around when to go deep on research vs when fast validation is sufficient, balancing rigor with pace, and familiarity with using research platforms (e.g. Great Question or similar) to manage recruitment, insights, and follow-up.
- Strong business and product acumen, with the ability to weigh customer value against business impact, delivery cost, and strategic trade-offs.
- Comfort engaging in technical discussions, reading code when helpful, and collaborating closely with engineers on feasibility and implementation details.
- Willingness to collaborate across time zones (Australia & North America), including regular early morning starts to meaningfully connect with customers and colleagues during shared working hours.

Strongly Valued

- Experience designing B2B or operational mobile products (e.g. field tools, logistics, inspections, healthcare, fintech).
- A track record of breaking silos and influencing outcomes beyond your immediate scope.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Figma Make, or similar) to accelerate design, prototyping, research synthesis, and insight generation.
- Familiarity with mobile platform constraints (Flutter, iOS / Android patterns, performance, accessibility).
- Experience working closely with engineers, including willingness to dive into implementation details or code when useful.
- Exposure to analytics or adoption tooling (e.g. Gainsight, Adora or similar) and using data to guide iteration.
- Strong synthesis and communication skills, with the ability to make insights visible and actionable for different audiences.

Why Join HappyCo?

- Make an Impact: Your work will reach millions of residents and thousands of property teams.
- Culture of Craft: We care deeply about design quality, user impact, and creative exploration.
- High Autonomy, High Support: You’ll be trusted to lead and supported to grow, with mentorship when you want it.
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: We offer hybrid and remote-friendly policies with flexible hours.
- Growth & Learning: Access to training, mentorship, and opportunities to grow your skills.

Our HappyCo Culture & Benefits 

HappyCo strives to build better communities. So naturally, we are dedicated to making our own community an enjoyable place that lets us do our best work. We’re devoted to building an inclusive, supportive culture that empowers each HappyCo’er to succeed and grow. To learn more about our culture, check out our careers page! 

We Offer: 

- Work from anywhere supported by a flexible company culture

- Opportunity to work for one of the fastest growing technology companies in the PropTech industry

- Generous paid parental leave

- Competitive and equitable pay, including stock options

- Access to employee assistance programs to support both physical and mental wellness

- Monthly stipends to support Wellness and Home Office expenses

Find out more about our AU Employee Benefits here!

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive, and building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company is core to our mission. Our goal is to ensure that HappyCo upholds an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, and veteran status. HappyCo is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. 

A note to Recruitment Agencies: Please don’t reach out to us about our roles -- we’ve got it covered. We don’t accept unsolicited agency resumes and HappyCo is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Product Designer, AI
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com .

THE ROLE 

We're building Zeta Developer Platform , our next-generation Marketing Operating System, and we need a Senior Product Designer who will be instrumental to its success. This role is a pillar position that bridges design and engineering to create the core foundation of the Agentic Apps Framework that will fuel our Zeta Developer Platform experience. You'll partner with our design system team, inform Model Context Protocol (MCP) improvements, and build the foundation—then scale—our Agentic and Vertical Apps infrastructure. You'll join at a pivotal moment where we're raising the bar on quality, speed, and innovation. We're looking for someone who can challenge us in the best way: bringing strong skills in AI, visual design, UX, motion, and coding to push our thinking forward and help us achieve what hasn't been done before.

This is a foundational role for a product that will define our company's future. You won't just be designing features—you'll be designing the core AI experience.

- AI is central to how users interact with the product, not an add-on

- Your work defines how users trust, understand, and rely on the Zeta Developer Platform every day

- You’re shaping a platform launching at Zeta Live 2026, with impact that compounds over time

THE TEAM 

We're evolving how we work to reach the next level:

- Vision over hand-holding leads to more creativity and innovation

- Empowerment and delegation leads to more accountability and ownership

- Strategy and clarity means less management, more impact

- Challenge and growth creates better outcomes through healthy debate

We value people who bring ideas on what we should stop doing, start doing, or change to elevate our team.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Design the Zeta Developer Platform Experience: Own and evolve the end-to-end Zeta Developer Platform experience, including conversational interfaces, contextual guidance, and AI-driven workflows that support daily user tasks across the platform.

- Design Systems Partnership: You’ll work closely with our Design Systems team to create, maintain, and evolve scalable UX and UI patterns for Zeta Developer Platform —ensuring consistency, quality, and flexibility as the platform grows and more teams build on it.

- Partner Closely with Product & Engineering: Work as a core triad partner with Product Management and Engineering to define strategy, behavior, and execution—translating complex requirements and technical constraints into intuitive, human-centered AI experiences. Confidently present work, rationale, and tradeoffs to partners and leadership to drive alignment and decisions.

- Advance AI Interaction & Explainability Patterns: Define how Zeta Developer Platform communicates intent, progress, confidence, and limitations—helping users understand, trust, and collaborate with intelligent systems.

- Raise the Bar on Craft, Motion, and Interaction Quality: Lead by example through strong visual design, interaction design, motion, and prototyping—using motion and micro-interactions to communicate system state, reduce cognitive load, and make AI feel responsive and alive.

- Scale the Zeta Developer Platform Experience: Identify opportunities to standardize UX patterns, documentation, and behaviors across Zeta Developer Platform —creating consistency while allowing flexibility where needed.

REQUIREMENTS 

- 8+ years of product design experience on complex platforms or systems

- Experience designing and shipping AI-powered or data-informed products

- Proven track record of close collaboration with Product and Engineering

- Experience influencing standards, patterns, or systems beyond a single feature

- Ability to balance craft, speed, and business impact

- Figma (expert level) — scalable component architecture, design systems, and documentation

- AI design tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar, used as part of daily design workflows

- Prototyping tools (Figma Prototypes, Framer, ProtoPie, or similar) for exploring behavior and interaction

- Motion tools such as Rive or After Effects or similar for stateful interactions and micro-animations

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend concepts

- Comfort working within modern product development tools and workflow

Core Skills 

- AI & Conversational Design Fluency: Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or assistive experiences, with a focus on clarity, trust, and responsible presentation of AI output.

- Systems & Platform Design Expertise: Proven ability to design scalable UX frameworks, patterns, and interaction models that support complex platforms and evolving capabilities.

- End-to-End Product Design Craft: Excellence across UX, visual design, interaction design, and motion, with the ability to make complex systems feel approachable and usable.

- Technical Collaboration & Prototyping: Comfort partnering closely with engineers, understanding technical constraints, and using prototyping to explore and validate interaction and behavior.

- Design Leadership Without Authority: Ability to influence outcomes through clear thinking, strong critique, documentation, and example-setting across teams.

- Cross-Functional Influence & Communication: Demonstrated ability to clearly articulate design thinking, rationale, and tradeoffs; confidently present work; and influence decisions across design, product, engineering, data, and leadership—especially in complex, ambiguous, or technically dense problem spaces.

Mindset & Approach 

- Ownership-driven leader who takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs

- Customer- and experience-obsessed, especially in AI-driven workflows

- Quality advocate with pragmatic judgment, balancing craft with speed

- Collaborative, Resilient Partner who approaches challenges with professionalism and empathy, engages in healthy debate, and maintains clear, respectful collaboration and communication.

Vibe Coding Tools

BENEFITS & PERKS

- Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Employee Equity

- Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

SALARY RANGE 

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000 depending on location and experience. 

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA 

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

Flexport IT is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer (Identity & Access) . In this role, you will design, implement, and administer our Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions to ensure secure, efficient user lifecycle management.

While you are our resident Okta expert, you are also a high-level IT generalist. You will oversee our broader SaaS ecosystem (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira) and endpoint management infrastructure (Jamf, Intune). Your expertise will drive automation, protect sensitive data, mitigate security risks, and maintain compliance in a heavily regulated industry.

You will continually strive towards automation of toil. If you are still manually doing the same operational tasks 18 months from now, something has gone wrong. Flexport’s book of business is growing fast, but the promise of technology is that we can grow our business faster than our headcount. The automation you build will be a key factor in that effort.

You Will 

- IAM Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain the end-to-end lifecycle of Identity and Access Management platforms.

- Okta & Directory Trust: Administer Okta, directory services, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced password management.

- SaaS Operations: Manage core collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, Slack, and Jira/Confluence.

- Unified Endpoint Management: Oversee our global fleet of Mac and Windows devices using Jamf and MS Intune.

- Lifecycle Automation: Build automated workflows for provisioning, deprovisioning, and application access.

- Identity Governance: Establish role-based access control (RBAC), entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.

- SSO Integration: Lead the technical onboarding of new SaaS applications for Single Sign-On (SSO).

- Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Security team to embed security best practices into our IT infrastructure.

- Documentation & Roadmaps: Author technical operating procedures, engineering roadmaps, and compliance policies.

- Operations Support: Provide high-tier technical leadership and escalation support for complex IT operations.

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in IAM systems engineering paired with broad IT infrastructure management.

- Okta Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Okta configuration, policy creation, and application integration.

- Core Protocols: Strong knowledge of IAM standards including SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, IGA, RBAC, and LDAP .

- Automation Skills: Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and Okta Workflows to automate IT tasks.

- SaaS & Endpoint Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf (macOS), and Intune (Windows).

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience.

- Compliance Mindset: A "compliance-first" attitude to navigate the rigorous requirements of a heavily regulated industry.

- Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities paired with strong collaborative and interpersonal communication.

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

THE OPPORTUNITY: 

At Salesloft, our Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

- Full-Cycle Account Ownership: Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.

- Driving Net-New Revenue: Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.

- Account Planning: Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.

- Proactive Retention Management: Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.

- Executive Relationship Building: Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.

- Forecasting & Pipeline Accuracy: Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.

- Market & Competitive Intelligence: Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.

- Collaborative Problem Solving: Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.

- Segmented Renewal Strategy: Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.

Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.

If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!
